medium.title: Ahead of Market: 10 Things That Will Decide Stock Market Action on Monday
medium.summary:
Indian equity markets closed Friday's session on a positive note, with both the Sensex and Nifty 50 posting gains in excess of 0.3%. The rally was supported by a combination of easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, a reduction in expectations for further US Federal Reserve rate hikes, the India-Japan Summit providing a positive diplomatic backdrop, and a recovery in the IT sector. For INR and bond markets, the reduced Fed rate hike expectations are noteworthy — a more dovish Fed outlook typically supports Emerging Market currencies and capital inflows into Indian assets, which could provide modest near-term tailwinds for the Rupee and G-Sec demand. Traders should monitor Monday's open for follow-through momentum and watch for any FII/FPI flow data that may confirm foreign buying interest off the back of these macro tailwinds.
